title: Highball engine manifest v0
description: A complete architecture-specific Wine runtime assembled from checksum-pinned components. Extra fields are permitted for v0 compatibility. Installation also validates URLs and version numbers and checks the staged engine files; this schema does not certify compatibility with games.

$schema.description: Optional editor annotation; the runtime does not fetch schemas.

minMacOS.description: One to three numeric components, each representable as a Swift Int.

channel.description: Catalog visibility: omitted for everyone, beta or preview for restricted channels. Explicit custom imports bypass channel visibility.

direct3D9.description: wined3d keeps Direct3D 9 with Wine in automatic renderer modes; omitted uses the normal overlay behavior.

acceptedLicenses.description: Installed state only. Importing this field never grants acceptance.

verified.description: Informational verification evidence; ignored by the runtime.

alternatives.description: Informational alternative sources; not installed by the runtime.

path.description: Relative path, with no backslash, NUL or parent-directory segment.

into.description: Destination directory or single file relative to the engine root.

strip.description: Legacy source selector; subpath takes precedence when both are present.

kind.description: Component classification; extraction is controlled by extract, not kind.

url.description: HTTP/HTTPS with a host or an absolute local file URL (empty host or localhost). Other URL semantics are checked at installation.

acceptance.description: License gate checked for optional components.

extract.description: If omitted or null, the source is copied as an executable plain file into tools/.

order.description: Defaults to zero; required components first, then optional, then order and name.

layout.description: Informational layout description; may contain globs and prose. Not a required-file inventory.

provides.description: Informational capability description; ignored by the runtime.

env.description: Legacy informational metadata; use top-level baseEnv for runtime environment values.

replacesTemplateRenderer.description: Legacy informational metadata; ignored by the runtime.
